title: Ministry of Rural Development Approves Road Works worth Rs. 211.71 Crore for Tripura under PMGSY-IV
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Rural Development

Ministry of Rural Development Approves Road Works worth Rs. 211.71 Crore for Tripura under PMGSY-IV

96 habitations in the State to receive all-weather road connectivity for the first time

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
24 JUN 2026 4:33PM by PIB Delhi

The Ministry of Rural Development has approved 96 road works covering a length of 163.872 km in the State of Tripura under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)-IV, Batch-I for FY 2026-27, at an estimated cost of Rs. 211.71 crore.

The approved projects will provide all-weather road connectivity to 96 habitations in the State for the first time. The enhanced connectivity will facilitate improved access to essential services such as schools, healthcare facilities and rural markets, thereby contributing significantly to the socio-economic development of people residing in these areas.

The provision of all-weather road connectivity is expected to improve the quality of life in rural areas and further strengthen rural infrastructure in the State. The projects will also contribute towards the Government's vision of a Viksit Bharat.

In addition to these approvals, the Ministry has, till date, sanctioned a total of 1,594 road works covering 6,284 km and 66 bridges in Tripura under PMGSY, involving an overall investment of Rs. 4,479 crore.

The Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana continues to play a pivotal role in bridging the rural connectivity gap and fostering inclusive and sustainable development across rural India.
